reuse.why: Makes the existing shared getScheduledAmount the single planner for every server and client site and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: Removes the five inline midpoint copies (forecast, schedule-template, two in schedules/app, preview); no logic is duplicated.

placement.why: The rule is in shared/schedules.ts, which both server and client already import from.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule and the API field. Every call site had to be touched because the signature changed (op inserted before inverse), which is acceptable but noisy.

maintainability.why: op is a required argument, so each caller has to choose explicitly (display sites pass null), which is clear. Reordering the positional inverse argument is riskier, and useScheduleEdit passes null in one branch and the op in the other.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gained one required op parameter that carries the rule's real variation; every site calls it
